headline: Liverpool have £50 million bid for Yankuba Minteh rejected by Brighton - sources
description: Liverpool have had a £50 million ($68m) bid for Brighton & Hove Albion's Yankuba Minteh rejected, sources told ESPN.

headline: Frank Lampard expects 'tougher times' for Coventry on return to Premier League
description: Coventry boss Frank Lampard said his side need to be ready for "tougher times" this season ahead of their Premier League curtain-raiser against champions Arsenal on Friday.

headline: Manchester City in talks with Palmeiras for winger Allan Elias - sources
description: Manchester City are in talks over a deal for Palmeiras winger Allan Elias, sources have told ESPN.
